review: Dieci Assoc. South Section 4 Director Meursault is an Identity focused on supporting mostly other Dieci Identities with a new effect called Erudition and trying to do damage at the same time. Unfortunately, what he offers is not something that Dieci Identities needs or could benefit from in a case or two. Let's start with rolls on the skills. At the base, Dieci Meursault rolls 10 / 16 / 17. Not very impressive values for a 000 rarity Identity. However, when certain conditions are fulfilled, those rolls (in a clash) go up to 13 / 21 / 24 and those values are good. Dieci Meursault's main gimmick is a status called Erudition that he can apply to himself and his allies. Said status grants shields when allies discard skills and once per turn boosts their clash power by 1. While Erudition is fine in itself, its benefits are either redundant or not applicable.
